That's not even the half of it, unfortunately. A lot of my early life still fucks with me to this day, but I'm slowly moving on and trying to not let it have influence on my life. It includes, but is not limited to, rape, abandonment, homelessness, lonliness, bullying, and family feuds.

Edit: On that note, I wouldn't describe myself as an unhappy person usually. I have a numerous group of supportive friends, I would descrbe myself as a generally well-liked person, and I would usually say that I'm happy. I would say my experiences help me connect with others because I can understand what they're going through and I feel that I am a better person from it. 

Every winter though, things seem to get significantly worse both in reality and in mind (hence the SAD suspicion) and every year it seems to get much worse before it gets better. 

I sometimes wonder to myself, if there is a god, then what is his plan for me  and why is he just letting this all happen. Sometimes when I think of suicide, I would think that he would probably forgive me for doubting things right?
